summary: Frontend regression test after iteration_6 LoginPage fix. Confirmed employee (budi/user123) now redirects to /employee/my-racks (NOT /employee/my-tasks) and 'Tugas Anda hari ini: A1, A2' banner is displayed with 2 rack cards. Blind-count regression on my-racks: expanding Rak A1 loaded products without any 'Stok Sistem' label/value visible, and clicking Tandai on a product incremented progress from 2/12 -> 3/12 and marked the item Selesai. Admin runtime redirect verified only via code inspection: LoginPage.jsx lines 18 and 27 route role=='admin' to /admin/dashboard; live re-test blocked by 15-min brute-force lockout (429 'Terlalu banyak percobaan') triggered by prior test iterations. Admin login functional in iteration_6 with same credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: Brute-force lockout is aggressive (15 min after 5 fails) and made re-testing admin login impossible in the same session. Consider distinguishing lockout scope by (username+IP) tuple rather than IP-wide, or resetting counter for successful non-admin logins.
